verdict.rationale: cubic's docs describe a one-click "Fix with cubic" button on review findings that generates the fix and pushes it to the PR branch. Fixes can also be requested from PR comments by tagging @cubic-dev-ai, using a configured coding-agent provider, and threads can auto-resolve once the issue is fixed. All of this happens inside the PR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the PR-native fix flow works as documented.
